title: DataSHIELD Environment Installer
text: Reproducible DataSHIELD runtime environments, server client. Website function reference: https://datashield.github.io/DSInstaller/ distribution set DataSHIELD packages, pinned versions, known work together. Distributions unique, date-based names (2026.04, 2026.10, …) never modified released. Two aliases point move time, Debian: stable: conservative choice, validated, dependencies pinned dated CRAN snapshot. testing: upcoming distribution. distribution split groups (base, resources, survival, …), can install packages domains need. group can require groups, included .

title: DataSHIELD Environment Installer
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("datashield/DSInstaller")

title: DataSHIELD Environment Installer
text: Distributions listed JSON registry, maintained repository (inst/extdata/registry.json) published package website https://datashield.github.io/DSInstaller/registry.json. ’s registry DSInstaller uses default. use another registry, set option environment variable file path URL: downloaded registry kept R session cached disk, cached copy used offline. Without cached copy, registry bundled installed DSInstaller version used.
code: options(dsinstaller.registry = "https://example.org/datashield/registry.json") # or: Sys.setenv(DSINSTALLER_REGISTRY = "/path/to/registry.json") library(DSInstaller)  ds_registry()                  # registry summary ds_registry(refresh = TRUE)    # download it again ds_distributions()             # one row per distribution, with its aliases ds_distribution("stable")      # details: status, R version, CRAN snapshot, groups, packages

title: DataSHIELD Environment Installer
text: List client packages distribution, groups: Compare installed: (Output trimmed relevant columns.) Install expected version. Missing outdated packages installed, newer ones downgraded: Dependencies come distribution’s CRAN snapshot. keep DataSHIELD packages pinned get --date dependencies, override repositories:
code: ds_packages("stable", side = "client", groups = "survival") ds_status("stable", side = "client") #>                  name version installed    state #>          dsBaseClient   6.3.1     6.3.0 outdated #>                   DSI   1.7.1     1.8.0    newer #>                DSOpal   1.5.0     1.5.0       ok #>   DSMolgenisArmadillo   2.0.9      <NA>  missing #>      dsSurvivalClient   2.2.0      <NA>  missing ds_install("stable", side = "client", groups = "survival", dry_run = TRUE)  # what would be done ds_install("stable", side = "client", groups = "survival") ds_install("stable", side = "client", repos = getOption("repos"))
